What we score

Six dimensions every college essay is graded on

Our college essay grader reads every essay on the same six dimensions, each scored 1–10 and weighted equally into your 100-point college essay score. Full Review backs every score with a quote from your own essay.

01

Narrative Strength

Does the essay tell a story with a real arc — a clear beginning, a turn, and a resolution that earns its ending?

02

Specificity

Are the details concrete enough that this essay could only have been written by this applicant?

03

Reflection & Insight

How deep is the reflection — does it show a genuine change in thinking or behaviour, not just a lesson stated at the end?

04

Authentic Voice

Does it sound like a real seventeen-year-old, or like a thesaurus with a deadline?

05

Writing Execution

Are the sentences controlled — structure, transitions, rhythm, grammar — without straining for effect?

06

Overall Admissions Value

What does an admissions officer learn here that the transcript cannot tell them?

How it works

How the college essay grader works

  1. Step 1

    Paste your draft

    Paste your college essay — a Common App personal essay, UC PIQ or supplemental essay of 50 to 800 words. Nothing else to set up.

  2. Step 2

    Get your essay scored in seconds

    The college essay grader returns a 100-point essay score, six dimension scores from 1 to 10, and one clear sentence on each.

  3. Step 3

    Revise with direction

    Quick Review tells you the next change to make to your essay. Full Review gives quotes from your essay, three priorities, and paragraph notes.

By prompt

Grade your college essay against a specific prompt

Pick your prompt and the college essay grader checks how well your essay answers that exact essay question, on the same six dimensions.

Straight answers

What this college essay grader will and won’t do

It will

  • Score every college essay on the same six dimensions, with a fixed 100-point formula.
  • Back its notes with lines quoted from your essay — each quote is checked against your text before you see it.
  • Read your essay against the application prompt you give it.
  • Keep the same scores when you go from Quick Review to Full Review on the same draft.
  • Show how your score moves as you revise the same essay.

It won’t

  • Write or rewrite your college essay. The words stay yours.
  • Invent experiences, or suggest you claim things you didn’t do.
  • Predict whether you will be admitted anywhere.
  • Sell your essay or use it to train AI models.
  • Replace a counselor, teacher, or other human reader who knows you.

A fair question

Why use a college essay grader instead of ChatGPT?

A general chatbot can give useful writing advice. A college essay grader built for one job gives every essay a measurement you can trust from draft to draft.

The same rubric every time

A chat assistant answers whatever you ask, and the answer shifts with how you ask. Here every essay is read against the same six admissions-focused dimensions, so two drafts can actually be compared.

Evidence you can check

Feedback that quotes your essay is verified against your text before you see it, so it cannot cite lines you never wrote.

Critical, not just encouraging

General assistants tend to be agreeable. The grader is told to give an honest assessment, a 10 needs clear, repeated evidence in your essay, and a perfect score across the board is treated as suspect and re-checked.

No ghostwriting

Chat tools readily rewrite paragraphs for you. This grader never does — it points at what to revise, which keeps your voice and keeps you clear of honesty policies.

Pricing

FAQ

College essay grader FAQ

How does this college essay grader work?
Paste your Common App personal essay and it is scored by an AI model against six admissions-focused dimensions: narrative strength, specificity, reflection and insight, authentic voice, writing execution, and overall admissions value. You get a 100-point overall score, a 1–10 score per dimension, and a short comment on each.

How accurate is the college essay score?
It is a structured second read of the writing, not an admissions decision or a standardized score used by colleges. Scores can vary between reviews, so use the dimension comments and quoted evidence to guide revision rather than treating the number as a prediction of admission.

Will the college essay grader write my essay for me?
No. It never rewrites your essay and never invents experiences. Feedback points at specific passages and suggests what to strengthen, so the words on the page stay yours — which is also what admissions officers expect.

Is my college essay private?
Your essay and any application prompt you provide are sent to our AI provider only to produce the review. Signed in, they are stored with your report in your account, and you can delete any review from your dashboard to remove them from our database. A review run while signed out is deleted within 24 hours unless you sign in to keep it.

How is the 100-point score calculated?
The 6 dimension scores are weighted equally: total score = round(sum of the six scores ÷ 60 × 100). Six scores of 5.5 therefore produce a total of 55, and Quick and Full Review always use the same scale.

Can I grade supplemental essays too?
Yes. Any essay between 50 and 800 words works, including supplemental prompts, scholarship essays, and personal statements for schools that do not use the Common App. The dimensions are written for personal narrative writing, so highly technical prompts will score lower on reflection by design.

How is this different from an admissions consultant?
A consultant brings judgment about your specific story and school list, and can take days to respond. This tool gives you an immediate first read, then a Full Review adds evidence-backed feedback on what to revise. Many students use both: the grader for quick direction, a human reader for the final call.

Do I need an account?
Not to see your score. Paste your essay and you get the 100-point score and all six dimension scores without signing up. The written notes — what is working, a note on each dimension, and the next change to make — unlock with a free account (sign in with Google). The review is then saved to your account as its one free Quick Review. Full Review is $4.99 per essay (5,000 credits).

Can I grade my essay against a specific prompt?
Yes. Paste the prompt into the optional prompt field, or open the page for your prompt — all seven Common App prompts and all eight UC Personal Insight Questions have one, with the prompt already filled in and a short guide to what it is really asking.

Can I see whether my revisions are working?
Yes. When you grade a revised draft of an essay you graded before, the result shows how the overall score and each dimension moved since your last draft, and your review history marks the change next to each score.

Last updated November 18, 2026

How does this college essay grader work?
Paste your Common App personal essay and it is scored by an AI model against six admissions-focused dimensions: narrative strength, specificity, reflection and insight, authentic voice, writing execution, and overall admissions value. You get a 100-point overall score, a 1–10 score per dimension, and a short comment on each.

How accurate is the college essay score?
It is a structured second read of the writing, not an admissions decision or a standardized score used by colleges. Scores can vary between reviews, so use the dimension comments and quoted evidence to guide revision rather than treating the number as a prediction of admission.

What we score

Six dimensions every college essay is graded on

Our college essay grader reads every essay on the same six dimensions, each scored 1–10 and weighted equally into your 100-point college essay score. Full Review backs every score with a quote from your own essay.

01

Narrative Strength

Does the essay tell a story with a real arc — a clear beginning, a turn, and a resolution that earns its ending?

02

特异性

Are the details concrete enough that this essay could only have been written by this applicant?

03

Reflection & Insight

How deep is the reflection — does it show a genuine change in thinking or behaviour, not just a lesson stated at the end?

04

Authentic Voice

Does it sound like a real seventeen-year-old, or like a thesaurus with a deadline?

05

Writing Execution

Are the sentences controlled — structure, transitions, rhythm, grammar — without straining for effect?

06

Overall Admissions Value

What does an admissions officer learn here that the transcript cannot tell them?

直接回答

What this college essay grader will and won’t do

It will

  • Score every college essay on the same six dimensions, with a fixed 100-point formula.
  • Back its notes with lines quoted from your essay — each quote is checked against your text before you see it.
  • Read your essay against the application prompt you give it.
  • Keep the same scores when you go from Quick Review to Full Review on the same draft.
  • Show how your score moves as you revise the same essay.

It won’t

  • Write or rewrite your college essay. The words stay yours.
  • Invent experiences, or suggest you claim things you didn’t do.
  • Predict whether you will be admitted anywhere.
  • Sell your essay or use it to train AI models.
  • Replace a counselor, teacher, or other human reader who knows you.

A fair question

Why use a college essay grader instead of ChatGPT?

A general chatbot can give useful writing advice. A college essay grader built for one job gives every essay a measurement you can trust from draft to draft.

The same rubric every time

A chat assistant answers whatever you ask, and the answer shifts with how you ask. Here every essay is read against the same six admissions-focused dimensions, so two drafts can actually be compared.

Evidence you can check

Feedback that quotes your essay is verified against your text before you see it, so it cannot cite lines you never wrote.

Critical, not just encouraging

General assistants tend to be agreeable. The grader is told to give an honest assessment, a 10 needs clear, repeated evidence in your essay, and a perfect score across the board is treated as suspect and re-checked.

No ghostwriting

Chat tools readily rewrite paragraphs for you. This grader never does — it points at what to revise, which keeps your voice and keeps you clear of honesty policies.
